transcript.answer: I do not know. I found no p95 response-latency target for get_booking_status in production. The get_booking_status tool contract has no latency target, and neither does the TMS tools spec I could read. The only latency figures are a 10,000 ms TMS request timeout (TMS_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS) and a worst-case turn latency of 60,000 ms. That worst case comes from six tool-execution rounds at the 10 s timeout. FR-059 also says that no real TMS latency has been measured yet. These are a timeout and a worst-case bound, not a p95 target.
